'''Tagar Spinebreaker''' was the chieftain of the cannibalistic [[Bonechewer clan]].

Shortly after the [[Bleeding Hollow clan]]'s return to Draenor, [[Ner'zhul]] sent [[Dentarg]] to influence warriors from the [[Thunderlord clan]] to join in the battle against Tagar's clan, who possessed the [[Skull of Gul'dan]]. The Slayer of the Shadowmoon clan was sent to help rally the Thunderlords and destroy the Bonechewers with the aid of the [[Shattered Hand clan|Shattered Hand]].<ref>[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/The_Skull_of_Gul%27dan_(WC2_Orc) The Skull of Gul'dan (WC2 Orc)]</ref> Tagar, who was eager to lead his clan to glorious battle in the human lands, schemed with [[Fenris the Hunter]] to journey to Azeroth and have their clans triumph where [[Orgrim Doomhammer]] had failed. This was not a vision that was shared by [[Ner'zhul]], who ordered that their clans be culled as an example to ensure that none would dare to interfere with his dark schemes.<ref>[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Thunderlord_and_Bonechewer_(WC2_Orc) Thunderlord and Bonechewer (WC2 Orc)]</ref>

Tagar's subsequent fate is unknown, but his clan survived the destruction wrought upon them and remained part of the Horde of Draenor's forces, assisting with the retrieval of the Jeweled Scepter of Sargeras<ref>[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/The_Tomb_of_Sargeras_(WC2x_Orc) The Tomb of Sargeras (WC2x Orc)]</ref> and being present during the [[Alliance Expedition]]'s later foray into Draenor.<ref>[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Upon_the_Shadowed_Seas_(WC2_Human) Upon the Shadowed Seas (WC2 Human)]</ref><ref>[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/The_Fall_of_Auchindoun_(WC2_Human) The Fall of Auchindoun (WC2 Human)]</ref><ref>[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Deathwing_(WC2_Human) Deathwing (WC2 Human)]</ref><ref>[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/The_Heart_of_Evil_(WC2_Human) The Heart of Evil (WC2 Human)]</ref><ref>[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Siege_of_Vanguard_(WC2_Human) Siege of Vanguard (WC2 Human)]</ref><ref>[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Coast_of_Bones_(WC2_Human) Coast of Bones (WC2 Human)]</ref>
